blocks.text: Networking devices network mein computers aur doosre devices ko jorne ke liye istemal hote hain. Yeh devices data ke bahao (flow) ko control karte hain. Baat-cheet mein har device ka apna khaas kaam hai.

Network Interface Card kisi device ko network se jurne deta hai (jaise Figure 1.6 mein). Yeh wired bhi ho sakta hai aur wireless bhi. Har NIC ka ek munfarid (unique, sirf usi ka) pata hota hai jise MAC address kehte hain. NIC network se data bhejta aur wusool karta hai. NIC ke baghair device network par baat nahi kar sakta. Zyada tar naye devices mein NIC pehle se laga hota hai.

blocks.alt: Network interface card: chips aur sunehri connector wala sabz circuit board, jo dhaat ki patti (bracket) se laga hai; bracket par lage socket ka label Ethernet Port hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.6: Network Interface Card (NIC) (kitab ki Figure 1.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Switch devices ko jorta hai aur data sirf sahi device ko bhejta hai. Switch network ki raftar aur efficiency (kam waqt mein zyada kaam) behtar karte hain. Aaj ke networks mein switch aam hain.

Router mukhtalif networks ko aapas mein jorta hai. Yeh data packets ko un ki sahi manzil ki taraf bhejta hai. Router local networks ko Internet se jorte hain. Yeh data bhejne ke liye IP addresses istemal karte hain. Router network ki security aur control behtar karte hain. Ghar aur daftar ke networks mein router bohat istemal hote hain.

Modem local network ko Internet Service Provider (ISP) se jorta hai. Yeh digital data ko aise signals mein badalta hai jo line par bheje ja sakein. Yeh aane wale signals ko wapas digital shakal mein bhi badalta hai. Modem cable, DSL ya fiber connections ke saath istemal hote hain. Internet tak pohanch modem par munhasir hai. Modem aksar router ke saath kaam karte hain.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Ustad signal badalne ki misaal se modem samjhayein. Talaba us ka khulasa (summary) likhein.

Wireless access point Wi-Fi deta hai. Yeh wireless devices ko network se jurne deta hai (jaise Figure 1.7 mein). Yeh wireless network ka coverage (pohanch ka ilaqa) barhata hai. Access points bari imaraton aur campuses mein istemal hote hain. Yeh signal ki taqat aur stability (thehrao) behtar karte hain. Wireless access points mobile connectivity mein madad dete hain.

blocks.alt: Antenna wala wireless access point neeche rakhe mobile phone, laptop aur desktop computer ki taraf Wi-Fi lehrein aur signal bhejta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.7: Wireless access point (kitab ki Figure 1.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Switch aur router mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Switch aik network ke andar devices jorta aur data sahi device ko bhejta hai; router mukhtalif networks (maslan ghar ka network aur Internet) jorta aur IP addresses se un ke darmiyan packets bhejta hai.
Network interface card (NIC) ka munfarid pata, jo device ke network hardware ki pehchan karata hai.

items: NIC: device ko network se jorta hai; har NIC ka MAC address.
Switch: network ke andar data sahi device ko. Router: networks ko jorta hai, IP addresses se.
Modem: digital data ko signals mein aur wapas badalta hai; ISP tak.
Access point: wireless devices ke liye Wi-Fi.
